External display: use this area as a touchpad and the keyboard below for input.
Cannot use this display. The session is still running.
Direct local GUI display (experimental)

Reads the local framebuffer directly. Uses Xvfb for display and x11vnc only for input; packages are downloaded on first use. Applies to newly opened GUI tabs. Fixed starting resolution; no GPU acceleration.
Long-press GUI to split GUI and terminal

Long-press the GUI (🖥) button beside + to open session layout. Choose top/bottom or left/right and another tab to use GUI and terminal (CUI) together. The same menu restores one pane or selects an external display. A short tap opens GUI as before.
